name: magic
expr: M3 = magic(3); M4 = magic(4); M5 = magic(5); M6 = magic(6); M8 = magic(8);
comment: Sig: M = magic(N). N×N magic square -- rows/cols/diagonals sum to N·(N²+1)/2. Three branches by N's parity: odd (Siamese / de la Loubère), N≡0 mod 4 (doubly-even pattern), N≡2 mod 4 (Strachey). Bit-identical with MATLAB R2025b across N ∈ {3,4,5,6,8} (covers all three branches).
